title: Whole Film Inspection and Camera Preparation Workcorner
description: One static film inspection and camera-preparation workcorner scene, zero new independent models. Five whole qualified originals retain complete GLB mesh buffers, normals, hierarchy and full PBR at unit scale through translation-only wrappers: a raised crank desk carries a whole hand-crank rewind/inspection bench; a separate lower open wooden worktable carries an intact cine camera and a whole raised-clapper blank slate. The two parallel but offset stations have different working heights and a clear front approach on one scene-only finite floor. This is equipment preparation and film inspection, not the old still-life subject table aimed at by a camera and lights, or an empty portrait sweep. No old component is cut, recoloured, rescaled or counted as a new model. One scene and zero new models, five complete instances. Static illustrative equipment only: no rewinding, editing, imaging, exposure, lighting system, camera operation, load, ergonomics, accessibility, electrical installation or safe-workspace claim. Rigging, animation and interaction not made and outside this delivery.
